items.title: File Klage against the operating-hours order at the Verwaltungsgericht
items.quote: Innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe kann gegen diesen Bescheid Klage beim Verwaltungsgericht Musterarnsberg, Jägerstraße 1, 59821 Musterarnsberg, erhoben werden.
items.computation: The letter carries no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date, so the printed document date, 19.11.2026 (Thursday), is treated as the posting day. The Kreis is a general public authority (not a Finanzamt), so the statutory 4-day delivery fiction (PostModG, confirmed in force for NRW since 1 Jan 2025) applies without any weekend/holiday shift of the delivery day itself: 19.11.2026 + 4 calendar days = 23.11.2026 (Monday), which is already a working day, so Bekanntgabe = 23.11.2026. The Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung grants one month to file Klage 'nach Bekanntgabe' (§ 74 VwGO / §§ 187, 188 BGB): the day of delivery itself is not counted and the one-month period ends on the day with the same calendar number one month later: 23.11.2026 + 1 month = 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). 23.12.2026 is a normal working day in NRW (not a Sunday/holiday), so no further shift under § 57 Abs. 2 VwGO/§ 222 Abs. 2 ZPO is needed.

warnings: The exact posting date was assumed to equal the printed letter date (19.11.2026) because the letter states no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date; if the envelope was actually posted later, the Klage deadline shifts accordingly.

The underlying Bescheid is dated 18.11.2026, one day before the cover letter (19.11.2026); this is a minor internal inconsistency worth double-checking against the actual Bescheid document, though it does not change the one-month period calculated from Bekanntgabe of this letter.
